notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are here to announce the release date for Seaside Cafe Story!

The game will be available at November 4th at 7:00 PM PST! Be ready to open your seaside cafe and embark in an exciting and charming culinary adventure in Seaside Cafe Story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568780/ef214e476de57809e87ff64f6149d5416ca45413.jpg

See you soon at the cafe!
